description: This file is a shell script that performs tests related to the 'git rebase' command, specifically focusing on incompatible options between different rebase backends and verifying that the command warns and aborts appropriately when incompatible options are used.

methods.name: test_rebase_am_only
methods.description: A function to test rebase options that are incompatible with certain other options such as --merge, --strategy=ours, --autosquash, etc., ensuring that the rebase command fails as expected when these incompatible options are used.
